packageRules.description: Majors open as PRs (no Dependency Dashboard approval) and are merged only by the operator. Lower priority so a backlog of waiting majors never takes the slots from the weekly non-major groups.
Bundle all non-major npm updates into one weekly PR

@playwright/test and the Playwright image pinned in each app's ci.yml (customManagers below) are one dependency: one weekly PR moves both, so the CI image always matches the resolved test runner. Must stay AFTER the npm non-major rule, which would otherwise absorb the npm half. Majors are not listed here and keep the majors rule.
Bundle all non-major Python updates into one weekly PR
Bundle all non-major Docker tag updates into one weekly PR
Bundle all non-major GitHub Actions updates into one weekly PR
Bundle all non-major Gradle / Maven updates into one weekly PR

Internal shared cores: own non-major group. PAIRED with minimumReleaseAge 0 below and with the automerge:false override in auto-merge.json - with no soak, the weekly routine's changelog check is the only delay between publish and merge, so these must never auto-merge.

Internal shared cores come from repos with mandatory independent review, so the seven-day soak buys nothing and starves consumers already on a recent release. PAIRED with automerge:false in auto-merge.json.
Skip MUI v9 — new pricing model (~3x cost, per-app license). Stay on current major lines, keep receiving patches and minors.

customManagers.description: The Playwright image in an app's ci.yml (e2e-playwright-image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:vX.Y.Z-noble) is read as the @playwright/test version, so Renovate updates it together with the npm dependency (see the playwright rule). The trailing comment that repeats the version is rewritten in the same edit when present.
